{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    H,W=15,23
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # two full-width horizontal colored separator lines, with sparse objects between/above/below
    r1=rng.choice([4,5,6,7]); r2=rng.choice([12,13,14])
    if r2<=r1+3: r2=r1+6
    c1,c2=rng.sample([1,3,5,7,8,9],2)
    g[r1]=[c1]*W; g[r2]=[c2]*W
    # isolated points and a small pair/block, mostly in regions
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2,4)):
        r=rng.randrange(0,r1); col=rng.randrange(W)
        g[r][col]=rng.choice([1,3,7])
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        r=rng.randrange(r1+1,r2); col=rng.randrange(W)
        g[r][col]=rng.choice([1,3,7])
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,2)):
        r=rng.randrange(r2+1,H); col=rng.randrange(W)
        g[r][col]=rng.choice([1,3,7])
    rr=rng.randrange(0,H); cc=rng.randrange(W-2)
    col=rng.choice([1,3,7]); g[rr][cc]=col; g[rr][cc+1]=col
    return g"}
